lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I must inquire,

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: doth everyone still live?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Should thy flame remain unsnuffed, send a dot.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: And what of the others?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Do they reside in areas scant of signal?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Forsooth, leaving a message is my only recourse.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: 3.3km to the right of Unlimited base,

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: a Nikke squad, having fallen behind, hath been found.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I hath lost their trail due to the avalanche.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: To mine eyes, it doth seem they traversed some distance

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: ensuing our separation.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Should any of thee in thy peregrinations chance upon them,

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: do as a lodestar would and bring them to the Unlimited base.
There has been no reply for some time...
I begin to worry about that Nikke squad.
I'll help rescue them.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
No. There's no need.
I'm passing through there soon.
I'll handle it.
Thank you.
There has been no reply from Snow White for a while...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
Sorry to have kept you waiting.
Just now, I found the Nikke squad Scarlet mentioned.
Did you really?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
Yep.
They were taking cover several kilometers away from the location reported.
Seems like they encountered Rapture groups several times during that period.
How are they doing?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
The three of them are all seriously injured.
One of them has severe wounds on her abdomen. 
The other two suffer from serious bleeding in the head.
Contact Unlimited.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Even Seraphim can't save them.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
Rapunzel,
I sent you the coordinates.
When you pass through here, please take care of them.
Wait a moment.
The group chat remains quiet for some time...
Share the coordinates with us, and Counters and I will be there right away.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Believer,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: it's all right.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I'm already beside them.
How are they doing?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: When I arrived, they'd already...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Now, I'm gonna offer a prayer for them.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: If you have anything to say,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: just leave it here.
I'm terribly sorry for not getting there on time.
May they rest in peace.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I think they've received your message.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: This must be so hard for you.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: But there are tens of thousands of variables on the surface,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: capable of causing innumerous tragedies,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: which are all out of our control.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: We're lucky enough to witness their last moments.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: That's how I feel.
... I get what you're saying.

... I decide to turn off the instant messenger for a while,
and offer my condolences.
